prompt: Create ONE individual complete-character 2D fighting-game sprite, polished cel shading with crisp dark contours, coherent with Digital Circus Encore. Keep all hat/bow tips, every hand, ornament, cane and the entire base/feet inside CLEAR TRANSPARENT MARGINS on ALL FOUR SIDES. True transparent RGBA. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, external glow, particles, text, logo, watermark, inset or duplicate. One original static game adaptation; do not copy the product scene or its squat toy proportions. Reference 1 is the APPROVED SELECTION SEED: strictly preserve its identity, proportions, colors, exact anatomy and polished 2D style. Reference 2 supplies the official product details only. Make a genuinely different pose, never a mirrored or cropped copy of selection. DESIGN LOCK: ONE entire Intermission Caine: a giant upright open orange-coral denture mouth with clean white teeth and orange interior. The mouth is the entire body: NO human torso, jacket, neck, legs or feet. Exactly TWO eyes: one ROUND WHITE eye with BLUE iris high on viewer-right, and one WHITE STAR-SHAPED eye with GREEN iris lower/front-left inside the mouth. A small BLACK TOP HAT with RED band rests on the star-shaped eye. Exactly FOUR separate WHITE GLOVE HANDS around the mouth, two on each side, without human arms or sleeves; one upper-left hand holds a BLACK CANE with a GOLD SPHERICAL KNOB. Exactly three small GOLD STAR ornaments stay close behind the denture silhouette as in the product. Preserve this one coherent magical character and its unusual anatomy. Never replace it by a normal ringmaster body, six-armed Caine, Bubble cluster, or another character. POSE: JUMP/ASCENT facing screen RIGHT: entire mouth floats diagonally upward, the four gloves gather nearer the mouth edges in a compact buoyant pose and cane rises along the silhouette. Full denture base remains visible; no legs or added anatomy, floor, shadow or motion marks. FOUR-HAND VISIBILITY MAP: exactly 1 cane-gripping glove at upper-left, 2 a separate free glove lower-left, 3 a separate free glove upper-right, 4 a separate free glove LOWER-RIGHT beneath glove 3. Adjust these four distinct positions to the requested pose while keeping all four countable. Do not merge, omit or hide a glove. No flesh or long arms: detached gloves only. Leave visible transparent gaps between the two gloves on each side.

observations: Four detached gloves are all present: one cane grip and three compact clenched gloves close to the mouth.
Whole denture base is exposed; airborne movement uses no legs, floor or shadow.
Blue eye, green star-eye with small hat and three gold ornaments preserve identity; entire cane and all accessories have margins.
visualReview.orientation: Mouth and round-eye gaze incline up toward screen-right in an airborne pose.
visualReview.scope: Original 2D pose adaptation from official merchandise; unchanged owner and combat kit.
